# SaneClip

> SaneClip is a private clipboard manager for Mac. It keeps unlimited, searchable clipboard history that can be locked with Touch ID and encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), skips copies from password managers, and comes with a free iPhone and iPad companion that syncs through your own iCloud account. $14.99 once after a 14-day full Pro trial (no credit card). macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon. Made by SaneApps (one indie developer, "Mr. Sane").

## Facts
- Current version: 2.3.26 (direct download)
- Price: $14.99 one-time for Pro. Every Pro feature is free for 14 days, no card. Pro is required after the trial. No subscription.
- Also available: Setapp; the SaneApps Bundle ($34.99 once: unlocks SaneClip, SaneClick and SaneHosts; SaneSales and SaneVideo are free); Homebrew `brew install --cask sane-apps/tap/saneclip`
- Requirements: macOS 14.0 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon Mac. iPhone/iPad companion is a free App Store download.
- Privacy: on-device by default. Clipboard contents never go to SaneApps servers. Optional iCloud sync uses your own account.
- Source code: public on GitHub (github.com/sane-apps/SaneClip), PolyForm Shield licence.

## Features
- Unlimited history of text and images, instant search by content, OCR text, notes and tags
- Touch ID or password lock on history; AES-256-GCM encryption at rest, keys in the Mac's secure storage
- Skips copies from 1Password, LastPass, Dashlane, Bitwarden and other password managers
- Skips text that looks like a password (on by default) and copies that apps mark as concealed
- OCR capture: "Capture Text from Screen" turns any screen area into a text clip; screenshots saved to history get searchable text attached (on-device, Apple Vision)
- Paste stack (FIFO/LIFO) that can record copies as you make them, snippets with {{date}}/{{time}} placeholders, pins, item notes
- Text transforms (UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, JSON, strip HTML/Markdown), paste as plain text, smart paste
- Clipboard rules: strip URL tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid), trim whitespace
- App exclusions, auto-expire after 1 h / 24 h / 7 d / 30 d, source-app colours, floating history window, drag clips out
- Shortcuts / App Intents, URL schemes, macOS widgets; export/import history as JSON
- On-device Rewrite, Summarize and Extract Key Points for text clips (macOS 26 or later with Apple Intelligence on; results open in a preview)
- Shortcut ⌘⇧⌃Y opens history; ⌘⌃1–9 pastes recent items

## When something else fits better
- On macOS 26 Tahoe or later, Spotlight keeps up to 7 days of clipboard history for free (Command-Space, then Command-4).
- Want free and open source: Maccy (MIT).
- Intel Mac: SaneClip does not run on Intel.
